title: Creation of mixed bone marrow chimeras with appropriate controls
protocol: Select recipient mice in good health, aged between 6-10 weeks and sex-matched to donors.
Separate mice into groups for irradiation.
Wipe down the mouse container from the irradiator with antiseptic and place the mice there.
Use an MDS Nordion Gammacell irradiator (GC40E) to deliver a total dose of 1100 cGy in two cycles of 550 cGy on the same day.
Take irradiated mice back to the colony for further procedures.
Harvest bone marrow from donor mice, ensuring at least 1 million cells per recipient are obtained.
Sacrifice donor mouse and spray down with ethanol.
Remove skin around legs and cut leg off at hip joint.
Remove skin and muscle by cutting and using Kim wipes to clean bones.
Place bones in a well with PBS for further processing.
Separate femur from tibia/fibula at the knee level.
Rinse bones with 75% ethanol, then rinse twice with fresh sterile PBS.
Prepare a 1.5 ml Eppendorf tube with 200 ul of PBS and place a PCR tube with a small hole on the bottom into it for further processing.
Cut ends off bone and transfer to new dish containing PBS.
Place femur/tibia together into tubes prepared on step 9.
Run a short spin in the eppendorf centrifuge to flush bone marrow cells.
Lose red blood cells with sterile lysis buffer.
Pass cell suspension through cell strainer to remove large fragments.
Count cells and resuspend them in PBS at a final concentration of 2 million/100ul.
Mix two different donor cells at a defined ratio for mixed bone marrow chimeras before injection.
Store cell mixture on ice until ready to inject.
Heat recipient mice with heat lamp until the tail vein is visible, ensuring they do not overheat.
Place mouse into restrainer with tail sticking out and wipe injection site with alcohol.
Inject 100ul cells (1 million) i.v. through the tail vein of the recipient mice using a 26 gauge needle.
Watch for clearing of vein lumen to confirm successful injection.
If not in vein, move more proximal until successful and apply pressure to injection site.
Put mice back into their cages and maintain them on antibiotic-water during two weeks (filter 2g/L of Neomycin Sulfate into water).
Analyze mice after at least 6-8 weeks.
